# Package signature fixtures

`author-signed.nupkg` is the Apache-2.0 NuGet.Client test fixture
`TestPackage.AuthorSigned.1.0.0.nupkg`, copied from NuGet.Client commit
`c82ceb9ad93dc8fdcb51fb6807c8e8c70f1443e8`.

`repository-signed.nupkg` is the MIT-licensed
`MessagePack.Annotations` 2.5.192 package published on nuget.org. It is also the
source package for the like-for-like signature restore benchmark.
